name: Dragon CRS-16
about: Dragon CRS-16 (2018-101A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon), launched 2018 Dec  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2018 Dec  8), held fixed
docked to A06499; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate)
